The following events took place in '''2510 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The small chambers used to hold the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], [[Sacking of Coruscant|ravaged]] by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the [[First Jedi Purge]], are reconstructed within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
